scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=apps/client" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/server"
scripts.dev:start: npm run db:up && concurrently -n client,server,studio -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=apps/client" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/server" "npm run db:studio --workspace=apps/server"
scripts.dev:stop: lsof -ti:8000,8001 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; npm run db:down
